intro.h2: A Greenville Contractor for Bathrooms and Tile
paragraphs: Watson Construction handles bathroom remodeling in Greenville from its base at 700 Sewanee St. The company has over 20 years of experience, and tiling and carpentry are its core trades, with flooring and countertops on the list too.

That mix matters in a bathroom, where the floor, the walls and the trim all have to come together. One contractor can handle the tile, the new floor and the countertop, so a bath or kitchen update starts with one phone call instead of three. Estimates are free, so you can find out what the job involves before you commit to anything.

items.blurb: Bathroom remodeling is what Watson Construction is listed for on Google, and it leads the services on the company's Facebook page. Talk through what you want to change, from the floor to the vanity, and get a free estimate before any work is scheduled.

about.text: Watson Construction is a remodeling contractor based at 700 Sewanee St in Greenville, Mississippi, with over 20 years of experience. Google lists it as a bathroom remodeler, and the trades it covers include tiling, carpentry, flooring and countertops. That makes it a practical first call for a bathroom that needs new tile, a new floor, a fresh vanity top and the trim to finish it off. Estimates are free, so you can talk through the work before you decide. Call (662) 703-1991 to discuss your bathroom or tile project.

service_area.text: Watson Construction is based at 700 Sewanee St in Greenville, Mississippi, and Greenville is its home town. If you live outside Greenville, call (662) 703-1991 to ask whether your project is within reach before you set up a free estimate. The work is done at your home, whether it is one bathroom floor or a full remodel with new tile, flooring and countertops.

items.a: Watson Construction does not post set office hours, so the best way to reach the company is to call (662) 703-1991 or email onewatsonconstruction@gmail.com. Leave a short description of your bathroom or tile project and the best time to call you back.

Yes. Watson Construction offers free estimates. Call or email to set one up, and ask what the estimate covers and how long it is good for, so you can compare it fairly with other bids for the same bathroom work.

Watson Construction is listed on Google as a bathroom remodeler. Its online listings also name tiling, carpentry, flooring and countertops. If your project involves plumbing or electrical work, ask on the phone how that part of the job is handled and who does it.

items.q: How long have you been in business?
items.a: Watson Construction has over 20 years of experience in remodeling. If you would like to see examples first, ask about recent bathroom and tile projects in Greenville that are similar to yours when you call (662) 703-1991, and bring photos of your own room so the conversation starts from what you have.

Ask for the contractor's license number and proof of insurance when you set up your estimate. It is a good habit for any bathroom remodel or tile project, whoever you hire, and keeping copies with your contract protects you if questions come up later.
